uiverify.description: UI Verify: visual regression testing for coding agents. Lets the agent check what its change did to the UI while it works: list builds, see which Storybook stories, Playwright tests or Vitest browser-mode tests changed, open the diffs, and accept new baselines. An AI judge labels each visual change as intended, a regression, or flake. Authenticate with a UI Verify project API key as a Bearer token. Docs: https://uiverify.ai/docs/triage-with-your-agent
